V2.desc: V2 baseline: stage-1 blend -> XGB stage 2 -> isotonic -> expected-F0.5

V3.desc: V3 full: stage-1 blend -> XLM-R (band) -> GNN -> isotonic -> expected-F0.5

V3_noGNN.desc: V3 without GNN: logistic stack of stage-1 blend + XLM-R (band pairs)

V3_noXLMR.desc: V3 without XLM-R = GNN without the XLM-R edge input (gnn_v2); in V3 XLM-R only enters as a GNN edge input, so ablations 4 and 5 are the same model

V3_GNNnoCos.desc: GNN(+XLM-R) retrained without the bi-encoder cosine edge input

V3_cosHash1_GNN.desc: V3 checkpoints, test cosine computed the validation way in the GNN edges only (stage 1 and XLM-R unchanged); validation is V3's own

V3_cosHash1_chain.desc: V3 checkpoints, validation-style cosine everywhere on test: stage 1 refit rescored, XLM-R band re-selected and scored, GNN edges

V3_V2decoder.desc: V3 scores with V2's decoder (isotonic folds 1-2 + expected-F0.5 with V2's gamma/extra)

V3_noIso.desc: V3 without isotonic calibration (expected-F0.5 on the raw GNN probability)

V3_thrMargin.desc: V3 with a simple threshold + margin decoder (tuned on folds 1-2)

V3_stage1halfA.desc: V3 GNN fed test stage-1 scores of half model A (the kind it was trained on) instead of the refit (gap_audit job gnn_cfA)

V4A.desc: V4A corrected V3 = V3 chain A replayed on test (stage-1 half A, XLM-R A on A's own band, GNN A) with the validation-style cosine: the test score is produced exactly the way fold 0 was

V4B.desc: V4B simplified: chain A replay without XLM-R (stage-1 half A -> GNN gnn_v2 A), validation-style cosine

V4C.desc: V4C V2-style: chain A replay of V2 (stage-1 half A -> stage-2 XGB model A), validation-style cosine
